'''John Nelson Howard''' (February 27, 1921 – April 15, 2015) was president of the [[Optical Society of America]] in 1991.<ref>{{cite news | title = Past Presidents of the Optical Society of America| publisher =Optical Society of America | url =http://www.osa.org/en-us/about_osa/leadership_and_volunteers/past_presidents/ }}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=John N. Howard {{!}} Optica |url=https://www.optica.org/about/newsroom/obituaries/2015/john_n_howard/ |access-date=2024-12-10 |website=www.optica.org}}</ref> He was the founding editor of the scientific journal [[Applied Optics]].  Howard was also a chief scientist of the Air Force Geophysics Laboratory.

He was a [[OSA Fellow|Fellow of the Optical Society]] and received the OSA Distinguished Service Award in 1987.<ref name=":0" />

In his later years he was a contributing editor to [[Optics and Photonics News]] (OPN).
